errors.allocations_cap: the fleet storage plan has too many allocations
errors.intents_cap: the fleet storage plan has too many device roles

operation_observations: Equal-value local setter still advances the clock and persists.
Invalid zero quota consumes a new actor clock but inserts no allocation.
Invalid policy/device/resource/cap checks occur before next_stamp.
Policy merge replaces its record but does not directly add a counter entry.
Only accepted newer allocation/intent records update counters.
Manager sender validation is nonempty only; it may relay valid other actors.
Ordinary member requires device==sender and actor==sender.
Equal stamps keep the existing value; conflicting equal input duplicates keep the first accepted value.
Input vectors above512 reject the whole patch even if all elements are invalid.
At capacity, an existing id may update; a new id is ignored; incoming order determines the final admitted free slot.
next_stamp observes maximum live-record counter and only the requested actor counter, checked_add without wrapping.
Setters restore affected record only after persistence failure; merge restores its full snapshot.
Load preserves arbitrary counters and truncates valid record maps by lexicographic key order after sanitization.
